proof_body:
by
  intro f g a b hab hf hg
  have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
    ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab (hf.pow 2)
  have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x * g x) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
    ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab (hf.mul hg)
  have i3 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => g x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
    ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab (hg.pow 2)
  have hq : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ (∫ x in a..b, f x ^ 2) * (t * t) + (2 * ∫ x in a..b, f x * g x) * t + ∫ x in a..b, g x ^ 2 := by
    intro t
    have h : 0 ≤ ∫ x in a..b, (t * t) * f x ^ 2 + (2 * t) * (f x * g x) + g x ^ 2 := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab fun x _ => ?_
      have h1 : (t * t) * f x ^ 2 + (2 * t) * (f x * g x) + g x ^ 2 = (t * f x + g x) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [h1]
      exact sq_nonneg _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((i1.const_mul _).add (i2.const_mul _)) i3,
      intervalIntegral.integral_add (i1.const_mul _) (i2.const_mul _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h
    linarith
  have hd := discrim_le_zero hq
  unfold discrim at hd
  nlinarith [hd]
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b) → (∫ x in a..b, f x * g x) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in a..b, f x ^ 2) * ∫ x in a..b, g x ^ 2
